sources.snippet: What is Genesis? Genesis is post training data regeneration and calibrarion algorythm for neural networks (LLM) in GGUF format that I made with AI help during almost half a year of development. It's optimized, architecture independent, works with any model in GGUF format and based on mathematical statistics. I don't train or finetune models, I repair purity of signal in them instead on Google ...
